finding: The shared PyTorch DCP FSDP1 restore failure is triggered by empty local shards of four-row last-layer optimizer tensors at world size eight. Actual planner diagnostics show complete original param_groups and metadata keys, then a legacy-format planner representation that mismatches the saved format. Both distributions pass the unchanged world-four fixture and the world-eight output-sixteen control.
scope: All three groups ran on the same two allocated hosts in sequence. No runtime implementation, checkpoint acceptance checks, or tolerance was changed.
The output-sixteen fixture is an explicit additional diagnostic control, not a replacement or repair of the original world-eight failure.
No claim that all FSDP1 checkpoint shapes/versions or all network topologies are verified.
